objects.name: authority
objects.description: A statute, judgment, regulation, treaty or contract that an opinion, brief or clause relies on.

indexes.name: jurisdiction
indexes.description: Listing the authorities binding in one jurisdiction, which is the first narrowing any research question gets.

indexes.name: rights
indexes.description: Finding every authority held under one reuse right, so a licensed report series can be audited before it is quoted in a published document.

objects.name: citation
objects.description: A passage of a draft pinned to the authority it cites, with the words relied on.

objects.name: cite_check
objects.description: A paralegal or advocate confirming that an authority is still good law, or that a citation says what the draft claims it says.

objects.name: passage
objects.description: One section of an authority's text, held so a drafting assistant retrieves and cites it rather than inventing one.
